capabilities: Define color, font, and CSS variables in a :::vars block in each note
Style text with custom wrappers, letter tokens, and nested styles
Write Python-like conditional rules to style lines and slices
Copy notes with inline-styled HTML to external apps
Replace list bullets with styled characters per indent level
extras: README carries a beta warning stating the plugin may contain bugs and directing reports to GitHub Issues. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define reusable inline color, font, and conditional line-styling rules inside individual notes.
summary: Reactive styling system that lets notes define colors, fonts, text wrappers, and Python-like formatting rules in a :::vars block.
